entries.mechanism: The couple_pit_oracle_pipeline is a CIR 1992 Article 87 marital-quotient slice whose supplied per-spouse boundary is professional income before the two pre-scale deductions EUROMOD BE_2025 applies: the 13.07% ordinary employee social-security contribution (Law 29.06.1981 Article 38) and the Article 51 professional-expense forfait (30% of remuneration after social security, capped at the indexed 5,930 EUR). Constructing the net professional base exactly as the single-worker pilot does — gross 63,301.34 EUR minus 13.07% social security minus the capped forfait, then the marital quotient on that net — and running it through the same imported rate scale, tax-free amount, and Article 5/2 autonomy factor reproduces EUROMOD tin_s to the cent (7,548.60 EUR). The 4,796.47 EUR difference is therefore entirely the SSC-plus-forfait base reduction the slice omits, not a rate, threshold, or marital-quotient error; the slice's imputation arithmetic is exact (its companion test reproduces both spouses' post-imputation income). This mirrors how the single-worker be-worker-pit suite reproduces EUROMOD once the same two deductions are wired.

Same slice base boundary as the 60k case. Constructing the net professional base (47,476.01 EUR gross minus 13.07% social security minus the capped Article 51 forfait) and applying the marital quotient gives 3,541.99 EUR against EUROMOD tin_s 3,484.26 EUR — a 57.73 EUR (1.7%) residual after the two omitted deductions, from the additional pre-scale net-income reductions EUROMOD nets at this income. The 3,516.65 EUR raw difference is dominated by the SSC-plus-forfait base reduction the slice omits.

Same slice base boundary, plus the low-income refundable credit. EUROMOD tin_s is negative (-808.58 EUR): the refundable Article 289ter/1 low-wage work-bonus credit exceeds the couple's tax and yields a net refund. Constructing the net professional base (31,650.67 EUR gross minus 13.07% social security minus the capped Article 51 forfait) and applying the marital quotient gives 787.72 EUR of positive tax; the 1,596.30 EUR gap to the negative EUROMOD value is the refundable work-bonus credit the slice omits (the same credit the single-worker be-worker-pit 10k case disposition covers). The 3,575.18 EUR raw difference is the SSC-plus-forfait base reduction plus that refundable credit.
